intents: Filter the events to rows where event_type is purchase.
Join the filtered events to customers on customer_id to get country.
Group by country and sum amount as total revenue.
Sort by total revenue from high to low and keep the top three countries.
Return the three countries with their totals.
notes: events has columns id, customer_id, event_type, amount. customers has columns customer_id, country, segment. Country comes from customers.
